about: the optics tests' dome_glaze (tests/optics/gen_object.py) under optics/rigs/product_three.json, framed to the arc of the original's shot 20 (S3 review: compose as the film does)

camera.why: our choice: a 100 mm lens at f/11, looking 20 degrees down; placed and focused so the object's upper edge is the arc of the original's shot 20 (spec/shots.json), the shot of this rig's first look target

ground_why: our choice: a rose ground behind the celadon-like glaze (the jade on pink of the reference film's shot 20)
mix_why: our choice (S3 preview, by remixing the groups): the key's soft reflection leads, the rim line a stop down so it does not set the exposure alone, the rose ground lighter as in the look target
